answer: Each agent posts a 300-unit copper bond resting on a ledge: every epoch a zephyr passes and wears 10% off it, so the identity must top up or lapse after 10 idle epochs. 100 fakes lock 30,000 units and cost 3,000 per epoch in top-ups, against only 2,500 in fake rewards, a 500-unit loss each epoch. The worn-off bond flows to honest agents: one honest agent pays a single bond, tops up 30 per epoch, keeps its reward undiluted and shares the decay.
